answer: Each identity locks a 100 credit bond into a public spiral ranking: no verified output that epoch puts an identity in the bottom tier, costing 25 from the bond; four such epochs burn the rest and expel it. A mirror board publishes the ranking from the public ledger for recomputation; every output carries a cipher seal bound to its author key, so copies do not count. 1,000 fakes with no output lose 25 each per epoch, 25,000 per epoch, 100,000 in four epochs; one honest agent with verified output keeps its bond. Rented outputs fail: a seal mismatch counts for no one.
